newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Siemens may bid on Argentina's airports - report.
newsitem.headline: Siemens may bid on Argentina's airports - report.

text.p: German electronics giant Siemens AG is interested in bidding for Argentina's airports, the daily Clarin newspaper reported Wednesday.

Asked whether Siemens were interested in any of Argentina's privatizations, Heinrich Von Pierer, the global head of Siemens told Clarin "We are interested in the airports, the hospitals and the information systems for personal registers. In telecommunications and energy there are limits, because we will continue as suppliers and we will not compete with our clients."
Von Pierer was one of the businessmen who accompanied German Chancellor Helmut Kohl on his three day visit to Argentina which ended Tuesday.
The sale of Argentina's 57 airports is expected to take place at the beginning of next year.
